scheme_name: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme
other_conditions: Must be an overseas scientist, faculty member, or R&D professional (including NRI and OCI) with an active research profile and proven track record
Must be employed in a leading academic, research, or industrial organization
Indian collaborator(s) must be regular faculty/researcher in academic/research institutions
Indian collaborators from top‑10 private institutions (per NIRF ranking) are eligible if the institute contributes 50% of the cost
benefits_summary: VAJRA Faculty receive up to US$15,000 in the first month and US$10,000 per month thereafter, along with travel, accommodation, and research support grants for Indian collaborators.
documents_required: Consent letter from overseas faculty institution for participation as VAJRA Faculty
